newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT OUTLOOK-Eventful week ahead of payrolls.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT OUTLOOK-Eventful week ahead of payrolls.

text.p: The bond market looks forward to a busy week culminating Friday with the critical May nonfarm payrolls report.

In the interim the market will digest another report on manufacturing strength with the National Association of Purchasing Management's May report on Monday along with personal income and construction spending. Car and light truck sales also were to start to be released on Monday.
Leading economic indicators for April were scheduled for Tuesday and April factory orders on Wednesday.
